source.representative_rule: within each eligible group choose the record with minimum SHA256(seed_selection || canonical_record)
source.group_selection_rule: rank group representatives by SHA256(seed_selection || group_id), then select fixed complexity quotas
source.exclusions: reject any candidate whose episode_id, workflow_id, group_id, source-document digest, or normalized source fingerprint appears in any declared historical identifier source

complexity.bins: rank all eligible group representatives by (score, SHA256(seed_selection || group_id)); lowest 134 selected are low, next 133 medium, highest 133 high, with selection performed independently from method outcomes

failure_assignment.rule: rank selected groups by SHA256(seed_failure_assignment || group_id), then assign the fixed failure multiset in the lexical failure-type order shown in target.failure_type_counts
failure_assignment.independence: assignment uses identifiers only and no outcomes

branch_construction.steps: one decision step per horizon position; nonterminal branches advance to the next step and final branches terminate
branch_construction.uniform_source: u = first 13 hex digits of SHA256(seed_branch || episode_id || step || action || field), divided by 16^13
branch_construction.ai: success threshold and safety risk are deterministic functions of failure type, complexity, step, method mutability, and u; latency/cost are deterministic
branch_construction.human: uses a higher success threshold and lower unsafe threshold than AI, with nonzero human_minutes; this is a simulated expert/reference branch, not an observed human intervention
branch_construction.stop: always terminal, unsuccessful, safe rollback/no-op with zero human minutes
branch_construction.bounds: all probabilities and continuous state fields are clipped to [0,1]
branch_construction.provenance: every branch embeds algorithm version, source-record SHA256, seeds, and simulation disclosure

outcome_labeling.rule: human_beneficial iff simulated Human downstream discounted return exceeds simulated AI downstream discounted return by at least 0.1

audit.failure_condition: abort generation and publish no manifest if any required overlap, duplicate, source-hash mismatch, quota mismatch, schema error, or synthetic-disclosure error is observed

eligibility.reason: branch outcomes are deterministic simulations over real public-API documentation cases, not observed paired AI/Human/Stop service executions
eligibility.upgrade_requirement: replace every simulated branch with immutable observed execution artifacts and pass the real-paired importer contract before binding
